opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three; up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post; must hold a doctorate by take-up; tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers
opportunities.summary: For early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work over 3 years, with joint support from the Trust and host university.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post at a UK university or eligible institution
opportunities.summary: For senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication. Application materials available September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities holding research degree awarding powers in their own right; consortia of up to two universities
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to fund up to 30 Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority research area, running over 9 years. Open for submission in March 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered by the Office for Students holding their own research degree awarding powers
opportunities.summary: For UK universities to set up a Leverhulme Research Centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Expected to open February 2027 for outline applications in June 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK
opportunities.summary: For experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research over 3 to 24 months. Application materials available September 2026.

opportunities.title: Centenary Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career scholars with at least two years post-PhD experience holding a permanent academic appointment at a UK university at lecturer level or equivalent
opportunities.summary: For talented early career scholars to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Opens January 2028 for submission in May 2028.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education; UK-based independent research institutes on a trial basis
opportunities.summary: For researchers to undertake an innovative and original research project of up to 5 years. Outline stage paused; detailed applications open until 1 September 2026 for invited applicants.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK institutions inviting an eminent senior professor from overseas; applications made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers
opportunities.summary: For UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring novel expertise and enhance skills of academic staff and students. Open until 1 September 2026.
